fact: Bayobab Zambia and Vodacom Moçambique launched a fibre interconnection at the Zambia-Mozambique border in February 2026, linking Zambia's inland networks to subsea cables on Africa's eastern and western seaboards including 2Africa.
title: Bayobab Zambia and Vodacom Moçambique launch strategic fibre Interconnection at Zambia–Mozambique Border
